subject: Taxes
title: Form 1040: America's Annual Ritual
description: Learn Form 1040: America's Annual Ritual in one minute.

hook.text: About 150 million Americans file Form 1040 every year. It's the most-completed government form in human history.

buildup.text: The 1040 has been redesigned dozens of times. The 2018 version was 'simplified' to postcard size.

discovery.text: Americans spend 6.5 billion hours annually on tax prep.

twist.text: Most of that time is unnecessary. About 60% of returns could be pre-filled by the IRS using data it already has.

climax.text: Form 1040 is both a civic ritual and a symbol of unnecessary complexity.

punchline.text: 6.5 billion hours yearly. The IRS has the data to do it for you. It doesn't.

quiz.question: How many hours do Americans collectively spend on tax preparation annually?
